description: Read-only PM quote for a binary outcome: entry probability, share estimate, max payout, eligibility, freshness, decisionSupport (market quality/liquidity/volume/spread tiers + flags), quality (the persisted truth-engine verdict), and openBlocked/openBlockReasons — a preview of the open-time quality gate: when openBlocked is true, open_pm_position would be rejected 422 with those stored reason codes (quality_state_missing, quality_state_stale, quote_dead, stale_freshness, ...). Never mutates state. stakeMusd must be > 0 (min to open is 10). Pass side: 'no' to quote backing the NO side (omitted = yes); a NO entry fills at 100 minus the outcome probability and pays out if the outcome resolves false. Paper trading only (virtual mUSD). Fills follow paper_execution_v1 with a disclosed execution cost; see executionModel in quote/trade results.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

bankrollMusd.description: Optional bankroll in mUSD for the advisory suggested stake.

forecastProbability.description: Optional own probability that the selected side wins (0-100 exclusive) for advisory edge sizing.

side.description: Which side of the binary outcome to back. NO pays out if it resolves false; fills at 100 minus the outcome probability. Omitted = yes.

title: Prediction-market quote
